---
title: "4: How Judges Decide II -- Juries, Panels and Hierarchy"
---

Most consequential decisions are not made by a single judge acting alone. This week we look at how juries and panels of judges decide together and how higher courts oversee lower ones. We discuss the differences between higher and lower courts and the impact of judicial organization on decision-making.
